commitResults.messageTitle: Implement milestone resolution flow and refactor get /students to use StudentId
commitResults.messageBody:
- add read-side milestone model classes:
  - ResolvedMilestoneStatus
  - ResolvedMilestone
  - StudentMilestoneView
  - MilestoneResolver
- implement milestone resolution as a derived display layer on top of stored milestone data
- compute overdue status dynamically instead of storing it in MilestoneRecord
- treat missing student-assignment milestone entries as default NOT_STARTED records during resolution
- preserve assignment order when resolving milestones for display

- extend Model and ModelManager with getResolvedMilestones(StudentId)
- wire milestone resolution through the model layer so commands can retrieve display-ready milestone views

- add get /students <studentId> /milestones command flow
- add GetStudentMilestonesCommand and GetStudentMilestonesCommandParser
- update AddressBookParser to route milestone retrieval before normal student retrieval

- refactor get /students to use StudentId instead of displayed list index
- update GetStudentCommandParser to parse student IDs
- update GetStudentCommand to retrieve and filter students by StudentId
- standardise student lookup syntax to forms such as S1 and S2 instead of numeric indices
- align student retrieval command format with milestone feature design

commitResults.messageTitle: Allow edit commands to accept optional field inputs
commitResults.messageBody:
Update edit formats so users only need to provide fields that are being
changed, instead of re-entering every field including unchanged ones.

Adjust edit parsing and command handling to support empty or omitted fields
while preserving existing values for fields that are not edited.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add comprehensive group model tests and refactor student references to use student IDs
commitResults.messageBody:
Introduce extensive JUnit test coverage for the new group-related model classes,
including Group, GroupManager, GroupName, and StudentList. Add tests to cover
normal flows, equality and hash code behavior, string representations, null
handling, duplicate cases, missing-entry cases, and student add/remove logic so
that the core group domain is validated more thoroughly and overall code
coverage is improved.

Include supporting test utilities where needed to make the new tests easier to
run and maintain, especially for constructing StudentId instances in a reusable
way across multiple test classes. These tests are intended to exercise both
success and failure branches and make regressions in group management behavior
more visible during future changes.

Update the success message format for add and edit operations to improve
clarity and consistency. Revise the user-facing output so that successful
command feedback is easier to read and better reflects the data that was
actually added or modified.

Refactor student referencing across the relevant logic from index-based access
to student ID-based access. This removes the need to depend on positional
ordering when identifying students and makes command behavior more stable and
less error-prone, especially when list order changes due to filtering,
reordering, or future edits.

Adjust the affected command and parser flows to support student ID-based
lookup and execution. Update the surrounding logic accordingly so that add/edit
behavior, command feedback, and student targeting remain consistent with the
new identification approach.
Implement the setting of milestones
